relationships.subject: DT-13
relationships.evidence_quote: the mechanism by which DT-13 exerts anti-inflammatory effects on M1 macrophages with sustained inflammation induced by LPS under high glucose conditions may be through the TLR4-NFKB signaling pathway

relationships.subject: DT-13
relationships.evidence_quote: the mechanism for inducing the polarization of M1 macrophages to M2 type may be through the ERK-STAT3 signaling pathway

relationships.subject: DT-13
relationships.evidence_quote: We found that DT-13 can promote wound healing in a diabetic ulcer model in mice.

key_findings: DT-13 promoted wound healing in diabetic mice and shifted M1 macrophages toward M2, with proposed TLR4-NFKB and ERK-STAT3 mechanisms.
